title: calamagrostis neglecta var. hookeri
intro: Calamagrostis neglecta var. hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Hooker's fescue include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of Hooker's fescue in modern medicine.
